ibperf._comment_install_perf_package: String "True" or "False" (not a JSON boolean). True: install_ibperf_tools clones perftest from GitHub into install_dir and builds it with ROCm on the head node. False: skip the build and use the perftest already in <install_dir>/perftest.
ibperf._comment_install_system_packages: String "True" or "False"; used only when install_perf_package is True. True: sudo apt install the perftest build and runtime packages, lshw and iproute2 on every node (skipped in SPUR/Slurm job steps; in a container, needs sudo in the image). Either way, install fails if numactl, lshw, rdma, libibverbs or librdmacm is missing on any node (after apt when True). Install always fails on a node without amd-smi (PATH or /opt/rocm/bin), which apt never installs.
ibperf._comment_install_dir: Directory shared by every node at the same path; perftest is built on the head node and run from <install_dir>/perftest/bin on every node. {user-id} becomes the cluster file username.
ibperf._comment_rocm_dir: ROCm install path on every node, such as /opt/rocm. Set a path, or "" to auto-detect /opt/rocm/core-* and then /opt/rocm. A path without lib/libamdhip64.so falls back to auto-detect.
ibperf._comment_require_dmabuf: True/1/yes/on (default) or False/0/no/off. True: fail before launching if perftest on any node lacks --use_rocm_dmabuf. False: run without DMA-BUF (recorded in results).
ibperf._comment_pairing_mode: Server/client node pairing: sequential (cluster file order), inter_vpod (each pair spans two vPODs - scale-out), intra_vpod (pairs within one vPOD)
ibperf._comment_vpod_source: vPOD discovery for inter_vpod/intra_vpod: afm (sudo -n afmctl show device --json; vPOD = scaleup_fabric physical_pod.id + virtual_pod.id) or cluster_file (node_dict[<node>].vpod_id)
ibperf._comment_afmctl_path: afmctl binary run through passwordless sudo -n; often /usr/sbin/afmctl. A bare name is looked up on PATH.
ibperf._comment_qp_count_list: Queue-pair counts (perftest -q) for bandwidth tests; each bandwidth test runs once per message size per QP count. Latency tests ignore it.
ibperf._comment_ib_bw_test_list: Bandwidth tests to run. Supported: ib_write_bw, ib_read_bw, ib_send_bw. Omit the key to run all three; [] skips bandwidth tests.
ibperf._comment_ib_lat_test_list: Latency tests to run. Supported: ib_write_lat, ib_read_lat, ib_send_lat. Omit the key to run ib_write_lat and ib_send_lat; [] skips latency tests.
ibperf._comment_msg_size_list: Message sizes in bytes (perftest -s), swept by every bandwidth and latency test.
ibperf._comment_gid_index: GID index passed to perftest -x; the same index must be valid on every NIC used. Set to 'auto' (or remove) to pick the lowest index usable on every NIC: gid_type with an IPv4-mapped address on RoCE, any populated GID (normally 0) on InfiniBand. To find it on RoCE, run show_gids, or ibv_devinfo -v -d <dev> and read the GID table, and pick the RoCE v2 entry whose address is the NIC's IPv4 (::ffff:a.b.c.d); sysfs has the same table in /sys/class/infiniband/<dev>/ports/1/gids/<n> and gid_attrs/types/<n>. Validated against gid_type on every node/NIC before perftest launches.
ibperf._comment_gid_type: Expected sysfs GID type for gid_index: RoCE v2 (default) or IB/RoCE v1; 'any' disables the type check. Not enforced on InfiniBand link layers.
ibperf._comment_port_no: First TCP port; each GPU uses the next one. Clients must reach their server on port_no up to port_no + GPU count - 1.
ibperf._comment_duration: Seconds each bandwidth run lasts (perftest -D). Latency tests ignore it.
ibperf._comment_verify_bw: String "True" or "False". True: fail a GPU that misses its expected_results threshold, for bandwidth and latency. False: record results without gating.
ibperf._comment_expected_results: Bandwidth: <test>.<msg_size>.<qp_count> = minimum bidirectional Gbps per GPU. Latency: <test>.<msg_size> = maximum average usec per GPU. Checked only when verify_bw is "True"; sizes and tests without an entry are not gated. Replace the sample numbers for your fabric.
